title: Phone app: ChatGPT-style shell (Chat/Code switch, feature cards, docked composer, drawer, Worked-for rows)
body:
Owner shared four ChatGPT iOS screenshots (2026-10-09) as the reference for the OpenAgents phone app. Match the pattern with our own components and words:

- **Top bar:** menu button left; a two-way switch in the middle (ChatGPT: Chat / Work → ours: **Chat / Code**, where Code means Coder work on a connected computer or project); new-chat/compose right.
- **New chat (Chat):** a row of tilted feature cards across the middle (like #11123's web cards: Explore the Verse, Meet Coder, Tour the codebase, See the roadmap) with one headline + one line + a **Try it** button; composer docked at the bottom ("Ask OpenAgents"), + for attachments, mic, voice.
- **New chat (Code):** suggestion rows above the composer drawn from the person's projects/issues (GitHub icon + one-line task), plus "Attach recent photo"; composer "Work with OpenAgents" with the current model shown as a small label.
- **Conversation:** user bubble right, answer as plain text; "Worked for 7s ›" row that opens the steps; rich link cards with a preview image on the right; floating composer pill at the bottom; scroll-to-bottom button.
- **Drawer:** "OpenAgents" title + search; top rows for the main places (e.g. Coder, Projects, Wallet, Verse when enabled, Settings); recent chats list with "See all…"; a **Chat** (new chat) pill bottom-left and the account avatar bottom-right.

Keep 1.0 scope rules (#11090: hidden features stay behind the preview flag; no dead controls). Screens checked against the references at phone size, light and dark. Reference images: scratchpad chatgpt-ref/IMG_4047–4050.
